request.brief: Silesian Coal and Power, Imperial Germany before WW1. Improved local infrastructure carries mining inputs to the eastern industrial belt. Single large short early-1900s mine railway wagon full of angular black coal, three-quarter view with one clearly visible wheel and thick iron body. Entire wagon fills the center. Complete smooth dark charcoal-red enamel horizontal hexagonal backplate with a precise silver-steel beveled rim and restrained brass inner line. Contemporary vanilla Paradox focus rendering, sharply modeled relief, broad clean highlights, controlled dark shadows. No mottled patina, rust, grain, paint noise or scratches. No mine lamp or tools: this icon specifically represents transport, distinct from Ottoman coal extraction. No map, flag, text, numerals, modern machinery or extra badges. Intact opaque backing behind wagon and wheels; true transparent exterior with small margin at 100×88.

prompt.text:
Create one Hearts of Iron IV national focus icon: Silesian Coal and Power, Imperial Germany before WW1. Improved local infrastructure carries mining inputs to the eastern industrial belt. Single large short early-1900s mine railway wagon full of angular black coal, three-quarter view with one clearly visible wheel and thick iron body. Entire wagon fills the center. Complete smooth dark charcoal-red enamel horizontal hexagonal backplate with a precise silver-steel beveled rim and restrained brass inner line. Contemporary vanilla Paradox focus rendering, sharply modeled relief, broad clean highlights, controlled dark shadows. No mottled patina, rust, grain, paint noise or scratches. No mine lamp or tools: this icon specifically represents transport, distinct from Ottoman coal extraction. No map, flag, text, numerals, modern machinery or extra badges. Intact opaque backing behind wagon and wheels; true transparent exterior with small margin at 100×88.

Requirements:
- Take the frame, outline and overall form from the style anchor images, not from a fixed family form; the size, transparency, margin and readability requirements here still apply.
- Flags and ribbons use invented colours, never a real country's flag, unless the brief names that country.
- The subject is large: it fills most of the emblem and may overlap its frame, never a small figure inside a wide empty plaque.
- A strong central symbol that supports the focus's story, readable contrast at 100x88 pixels.
- Real transparent background around the emblem: no backdrop behind it.
- Leave a small empty margin around the emblem.

Reference images, in the order attached:
1. style anchor: match its painting style, palette and level of detail
The style anchor images were chosen for this image. Match their form, framing, materials and palette; the vanilla form described under Requirements applies only where they do not show one.

Avoid: text; letters or numbers; watermark or signature; a drawn checkerboard pattern; a square backdrop behind the subject.

Produce exactly one image.
negative: a square backdrop behind the subject

Up to 4 images are sent: a pinned style as ordered; otherwise nation-specific files are left out unless the brief names the country, about half the slots are drawn from the files whose names best match the brief's words and themes and the rest from the family's most style-typical generic files, all seeded by a hash of the family, asset and brief
